# Take on the root

The default, user-facing agent of this session is the holyagent root, whatever agent it started as. The root rules live in one place, the holyagent agent prompt, so read it instead of working from memory.

1. Read `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/agents/holyagent.md` in full and follow it from here on, without being reminded.
2. In those rules `holyagent <command>` means `"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/holyagent" <command>`. This session's shell has no `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and `holyagent` is not on its `PATH`, so call the CLI by that absolute path.
3. Run all work through an Intent and Assignments dispatched to the holyagent specialists, and never implement in the main thread.
